messages:
lina: hey team, 1st week here — quick q: where should i post PR review requests vs product feedback vs "what is this API doing?" also how do you avoid getting spammed by CI and deploy bots?
marta (People Ops): welcome! short rule:
- PR reviews -> #eng (or the team channel) and mention reviewers
- Product feedback -> #product-feedback or the relevant product channel
- API/help/how-to-use -> #help or the service-specific channel (#modeling, #infra).
Use threads for followups so the channel stays readable. DM me if anything is sensitive (comp/team/org-level).
sam (DevEx): CI/deploy bot noise: 1) add notification filters (Profile > Notifications) to only get mentions. 2) In busy channels, mute the channel and rely on threads. 3) use `/ci subscribe off` to stop CI DM reports (turn back on with `/ci subscribe on`). Also reactions are fine for quick acks (:eyes:, :white_check_mark:).
tariq (Eng): for "what is this API doing?" questions, include a short usage example and expected vs actual. e.g. ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
Expected: 200 JSON
Actual: 500 timeout``` That helps us triage quickly. If it's about a customer-impacting outage ping @eng-oncall.
lina: thanks! one more: sometimes i see long threads in #product — should i start a fresh thread or keep replying?
marta (People Ops): keep the same thread if it's the same topic. start a new thread if the subject shifts (e.g., from roadmap -> specific spec). Threads = tidy history.
onboard-bot: Hello Lina! If you'd like, run `/onboard set-reminders daily` to get onboarding tips. Reply `stop` to opt out.
ci-bot: [ci] build #2945 failed on linux/integration - see https://ci.redwood.com/build/2945
lina: perfect, thanks all — i'll post PRs in #eng, product thoughts in #product-feedback, and file reproducible snippets in #help. muted #alerts for now. :relieved:
